name: Health Sciences Major

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: For the bachelor of arts (BA) health sciences program, students complete 120 units, which includes: at least 45 upper division units at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division CGPA of at least 2.0.

requirements.title: At least one additional HSCI lower division course
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete one of the following sets of courses in communications, ecosystems or politics.

requirements.title: One of: CMNS 110 + CMNS 130 + CMNS 202; GEOG 111 + GEOG 215 + REM 221; POL 100 + POL 200W + POL 210
2 of CMNS 120W, CMNS 130, ENV 100 and 15 more
One of ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W and 7 more
4 of HSCI 210, HSCI 211, HSCI 212 and 2 more

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: One of HSCI 449, HSCI 461, HSCI 462 and 6 more
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least 30 additional upper division units, of which 18 must be HSCI units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: These graduate courses must be passed with a grade of B (3.0) or better in order to be used towards the requirements of the master's degree.

sections.note:
NOTE: SFU students accepted in the accelerated master’s within the Faculty of Health Sciences may apply a maximum of 10 graduate course units, taken while completing the bachelor's degree, towards the upper division electives of the bachelor’s program and the requirements of the master's degree.
For more information go to: https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/programs/accelerated-masters.html .

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
